en.headline: New Wah Fu Estate phase one set to finish six years early in 2034
en.dek: Housing Authority paper to Southern District Council says earlier land release allows about 1,760 units in three blocks by the second half of 2034 for phase-three residents.
body: The Housing Authority has told the Southern District Council that the first phase of the new Wah Fu Estate is expected to be completed in 2034, six years earlier than previously planned, because land at Wah On House and Wah Lok House can be released sooner.

According to the paper, the phase-one site of about 1.5 hectares will have three residential blocks ranging from 26 to 48 storeys, providing roughly 1,760 flats and welfare facilities. The units are intended for residents of Wah Tsui House and Wah King House under the redevelopment’s third phase, with intake targeted for the second half of 2034.

The existing Wah Fu (I) shopping centre and the banyan-tree area will be conserved and revitalised as a community cultural plaza, with welfare facilities, outdoor courtyards, covered public space and a Wah Fu historical archive. Wah Fu North Estate is due to finish by the end of this year, after which residents of Wah On and Wah Lok houses are expected to move in; those two blocks are projected to be cleared in the third quarter of next year so demolition and construction of the new phase can begin.

To free a larger site, the Authority proposes realigning a section of Wah Fu Road between Wah On and Wah Lok houses. Gazettal is expected early next year, with works starting in mid-2028 and finishing in 2034, carried out in stages to limit traffic disruption.

zh.headline: 新華富邨第一期預計提早六年於2034年落成
zh.dek: 房委會向南區區議會提交文件，指華安樓及華樂樓用地可提早釋放，第一期約1760個單位預計2034年下半年入伙，供第三期居民使用。
body: 房屋委員會向南區區議會提交華富邨重建最新進展文件，表示由於華安樓及華樂樓用地可提早釋放，新華富邨第一期預計可提早六年，於2034年落成。
文件顯示，第一期地盤面積約1.5公頃，擬建三座樓高26至48層的住宅大樓，提供約1760個單位及社福設施，主要接收重建計劃第三期華翠樓及華景樓居民，預計2034年下半年入伙。
現有華富（一）商場與「榕樹頭」將保育活化成為社區文化廣場，設有社福設施、戶外庭院、有蓋公共空間及華富歷史資料館。華富北邨預計今年底完工，華安樓及華樂樓居民將陸續遷入，兩座樓宇預計明年第三季清空後，即可展開清拆及新華富邨第一期工程。
為騰出更大地塊，房委會建議重新訂定華安樓與華樂樓之間一段華富道路線，預計明年初刊憲，2028年中開工，並分段進行以減低交通影響，道路工程預計2034年竣工。
